page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highmem-96-lssd is a memory-dense compute instance provisioned with dedicated x86_64 CPU cores and integrated high-speed local storage. The system features 96 dedicated vCPUs alongside 756 GB of system memory, providing approximately 7.88 GB of RAM per vCPU. Storage architecture includes 3221 GB of local NVMe SSD capacity across eight pooled drives, eliminating reliance on network-attached persistent disks for primary scratch and working space. No discrete hardware accelerators or GPUs are included in this configuration.

The architectural focus centers on substantial memory density paired with high-throughput local disk I/O. The provision of 3221 GB of local NVMe SSD storage offers low-latency block access suitable for disk-intensive caching or high-rate transaction logging. Because local SSDs are ephemeral and tied directly to the lifecycle of the host hardware, workloads requiring fault tolerance must maintain independent persistent replication. The high density of cores and memory optimizes infrastructure consolidation, reducing per-node overhead for enterprise footprints while trading off burstable pricing flexibility.

This configuration is tailored for resource-intensive, memory-bound applications that also demand high local I/O performance. Suitable deployments include large in-memory databases, distributed caches such as Redis or Memcached clusters, data warehousing staging layers, real-time analytics engines, and enterprise ETL pipelines that manipulate large data volumes directly in local memory and fast scratch storage.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highmem-96-lssd is a high-memory compute instance designed for intensive workloads that require dense memory allocation and low-latency storage. Built on the x86_64 architecture, the server provides 96 dedicated vCPUs and 756 GB of system RAM, yielding approximately 7.88 GB of memory per core. Local storage is bundled as 3221 GB of direct-attached NVMe SSD capacity across eight physical disks, delivering substantial block-level throughput without the latency overhead of network storage. The instance operates without discrete graphics accelerators and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Delivering a balanced consolidation profile for large workloads, the c4d-highmem-96-lssd suits demanding enterprise database engines, in-memory analytical platforms, distributed caching layers, and high-volume ETL processing pipelines requiring massive RAM and high-speed temporary disk space.
